/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getOffgiveListCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM G_CNTR GC LEFT JOIN G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG LPWC ON GC.RCEPT_BANK_CODE = LPWC.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID , G_LOCGOV GL, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND GC.CNTR_PATH_CODE IN ('200', '300') -- (온라인 100/오프라인 농협 200/오프라인 행정복지센트 300) AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N'
AND GC.CNTR_SN = #{shText} -- 접수번호
AND CONCAT(UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOCGOV_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shText}, '%') -- 기부 지자체
AND GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{shText} -- 전자납부번호
AND (GC.RCEPT_BANK_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shText}, '%') OR LPWC.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{shText}, '%') -- 접수지점 )
AND DATE_FORMAT(GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{shFrstRegistPnttmStart} AND #{shFrstRegistPnttmEnd} -- 신청일
AND GC.CNTR_AMT BETWEEN #{shCntrAmtStart} AND #{shCntrAmtEnd} -- 기부금액
AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = #{shCntrSttusCode} -- 상태 (신규/취소)
AND GC.RCEPT_BANK_CODE = #{shRceptBankCode} -- 소속지점(은행)
AND GC.CNTR_PATH_CODE = '200'
AND GC.CNTR_PATH_CODE = '300'
AND GC.RCEPT_BANK_NM = #{shRceptBankNm} -- 소속지점명

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getOffgive */ SELECT CNTR_SN , GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM -- 신청일 , OU.LOGIN_ID as LOGIN_ID , OU.USER_NAME as USER_NAME , OUD.BIRTHDAY as BIRTHDAY , OUD.PHONE_NUMBER as PHONE_NUMBER , GC.INFO_AGRE_AT -- 행정정보 공동이용 동의 , POST as POST , ADDRESS as ADDRESS , ADDRESS_DETAIL as ADDRESS_DETAIL , GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'WDR') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , GL.LOCGOV_CODE AS LOCGOV_CODE , GL.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , GC.CNTR_AMT -- 기부금액 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE YEAR(A.CNTR_DE) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y') AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' and A.cntr_sttus_code = '200' and A.sttemnt_pay_de is not NULL) AS CNTR_AMT_YEAR_TOTAL -- 올해 기부 누적액 , GC.RCEPT_BANK_NM -- 접수지점 , GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO -- 전자납부번호 , GC.CNTR_BLCE_POINT , GC.CNTR_POINT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS CNTR_USE_POINT , GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE , (SELECT REQ_ID FROM G_CNTR_REQMNG GCR WHERE REQ_STATUS_CODE = '100' AND GCR.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS REQ_ID , NVL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_TTL, '자치단체기부') AS PRJ_SUBJECT FROM G_CNTR GC LEFT JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_MNG DPM ON GC.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID = DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_ID , G_LOCGOV GL, OP_USER OU, OP_USER_DETAIL OUD WHERE 1=1 AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND OU.USER_ID = OUD.USER_ID AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_SN = #{cntrSn}

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getOffgivePrint */ SELECT CNTR_SN , GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM -- 신청일 , '' -- 처리기간 , OU.USER_NAME as USER_NAME , OUD.BIRTHDAY as BIRTHDAY , ADDRESS as ADDRESS , ADDRESS_DETAIL as ADDRESS_DETAIL , OUD.PHONE_NUMBER as OUD.PHONE_NUMBER , GC.CNTR_AMT -- 기부금액 , GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'WDR') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , GL.LOCGOV_CODE AS LOCGOV_CODE , GL.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE -- 답례품신청코드 FROM G_CNTR GC, G_LOCGOV GL, OP_USER OU, OP_USER_DETAIL OUD WHERE 1=1 AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND OU.USER_ID = OUD.USER_ID AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_SN = #{cntrSn}

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getMaxCheck */ SELECT 5000000 - IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS MAX_CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(CNTR_DE) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getGCntrSumCntrAmt */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS MAX_CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(CNTR_DE) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getLocgovMapngCode */ SELECT (select upper_locgov_code from g_locgov where locgov_code = locgov_mapng_code) as upper_locgov_mapng_code , locgov_mapng_code , (select locgov_nm from g_locgov where locgov_code = locgov_mapng_code) as locgov_nm FROM G_INSTT_CODE WHERE locgov_code = #{locgovCode}
/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.getLocgovCodeByUserId (유저 지자체 코드 정보)*/ SELECT LOCGOV_CODE FROM OP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID , B.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , A.LCLGV_CD , B.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , B.LOCGOV_NM , A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM , A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_CD , A.USE_YN , A.FRST_REG_DT FROM G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV B ON A.LCLGV_CD = B.LOCGOV_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID = #{pbadmsWlfrCntrId}

/* saleson.shop.offgive.OffgiveMapper.selectOffRprs */ SELECT offr.lclgv_cd, offr.gds_id, offr.sort_seq, offr.frst_rgtr_id, offr.frst_reg_dt, offr.options, oi.item_code, oi.item_name, oi.item_image, oi.item_option_flag, oi.stock_quantity, oi.sale_price, oi.display_flag, oi.sold_out, oi.data_status_code FROM g_lclgv_off_rprs_gds_mng offr LEFT JOIN op_item oi on oi.item_id = offr.gds_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND offr.lclgv_cd = #{lclgvCd} AND oi.display_flag = 'Y' AND oi.sold_out = '0'

SELECT distinct ooi.order_code, ooi.filler9 FROM op_order_item ooi left join g_cntr gc on gc.cntr_sn = ooi.filler9 WHERE 1 = 1 AND ooi.filler9 is not null AND ooi.filler9 != '' AND ooi.order_status = '0' AND gc.cntr_path_code in ('200', '300') AND gc.cntr_sttus_code = '100' AND gc.sttemnt_pay_de is null AND gc.delete_at = 'Y' AND ooi.created_date BETWEEN date_format(to_date(sys_date - 90), '%Y%m%d') + '000000' AND date_format(to_date(sys_date - 10), '%Y%m%d') + '235959'
SELECT cntr_sn FROM g_cntr WHERE 1 = 1 AND cntr_path_code in ('200', '300') AND cntr_sttus_code = '100' AND sttemnt_pay_de is null AND delete_at = 'Y' AND cntr_sn = #{cntr_sn}
mapper.update: UPDATE op_order_item SET order_status = '99' WHERE filler9 = #{cntr_sn}
